annotations.title: Check a service before paying or connecting

description: Call before the first payment to an x402 endpoint, before connecting to an MCP server, and whenever a call to it fails. Give url (any https URL, listed or not: unknown URLs are probed now and detected as x402 or MCP) or id from find_service. Returns: alive, advice (ok / ok_requires_auth: working as listed; ok_terms_not_checked and unverified_yet: not fully checked yet; caution_*: a change worth confirming with the user — pay_to_changed, network_changed, price_higher_than_listed, high_price, tools_changed, suspicious_tool_description, buyers_report_failures; avoid_*: alalanet found a blocking problem — down, not_working_as_listed, sanctioned_pay_to, pay_to_frozen), trust_score (0-100, open formula at /trust) with flags, checked_at and last_alive_at (when it last answered as listed, so a dead answer says how long it has been gone), observed price, network and pay_to versus the catalogue listing, uptime 24h/7d/30d, host_listings and pay_to_shared_by_hosts, verified purchases, alalanet's own test purchase, for MCP the tool-set diff (tools_diff, tool_description_flags), and when the advice is caution_* or avoid_*, up to 3 working alternatives on other hosts. Default answers from recent checks (free tier: 100 a day); live=true probes now and adds a signed, logged attestation you can keep as evidence (5 live checks a day free). Read-only for the caller; an unknown URL joins the public catalogue. preflight_payment gives the decision for one specific 402. Docs: https://alalanet.com/skill.md.

id.description: service id from find_service results; give either id or url

live.description: true probes the service now and returns a signed, logged receipt; false (default) answers from recent checks

url.description: https URL of the x402 endpoint or MCP server to check; any public URL works, unknown ones are probed and added (private, loopback, link-local and cloud-metadata addresses are refused by an SSRF guard)
